checks.description: ALB/NLB listeners must use HTTPS or TLS protocol to encrypt traffic in transit
checks.impact: HTTP listeners transmit data in plaintext, exposing sensitive traffic to interception on the network path
checks.resolution: Set protocol = "HTTPS" (ALB) or protocol = "TLS" (NLB) on aws_lb_listener resources. Redirect-only HTTP listeners (action_type = redirect with redirect.protocol = HTTPS) are architecturally acceptable but are still flagged by this check due to tfsec's attribute-level evaluation — suppress with # tfsec-ignore:EEDOM-AWS-012 and a comment explaining the redirect intent
checks.errorMessage: aws_lb_listener does not use HTTPS or TLS protocol — plaintext HTTP exposes traffic in transit (set protocol = HTTPS or TLS; use # tfsec-ignore:EEDOM-AWS-012 for HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect-only listeners)
